name: CRM_DASHBOARD_TC_006 - Click mở dropdown Quick Create hiển thị đủ danh sách shortcut

steps.name: Before Hooks
Open Login page
Navigate to URL: "https://crm.anhtester.com/admin/authentication"

parameters.name: url
parameters.value: https://crm.anhtester.com/admin/authentication

steps.name: Verify element is visible: "Login page heading "Login""

parameters.name: locator
parameters.value: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Login' })

steps.name: Log in with email "admin@example.com" and submit the form
Fill field with value: "admin@example.com"

parameters.name: locator
parameters.value: getByLabel('Email Address')

parameters.name: value
parameters.value: admin@example.com

steps.name: Fill field with a masked value

parameters.name: locator
parameters.value: getByLabel('Password')

steps.name: Click on element: "getByRole('button', { name: 'Login' })"

parameters.name: locator
parameters.value: getByRole('button', { name: 'Login' })

steps.name: Open the Quick Create dropdown and verify it lists all expected shortcuts
Click on element: "getByRole('link', { name: '+', exact: true })"

parameters.name: locator
parameters.value: getByRole('link', { name: '+', exact: true })

steps.name: Verify element is visible: "Quick Create dropdown"

parameters.name: locator
parameters.value: locator('ul.dropdown-menu').filter({ has: getByText('Quick Create', { exact: true }) })

steps.name: Verify Quick Create dropdown lists all expected shortcut items
Verify element is visible: "Quick Create item "Invoice""

parameters.name: locator
parameters.value: locator('ul.dropdown-menu').filter({ has: getByText('Quick Create', { exact: true }) }).getByText('Invoice', { exact: true })
